Game Overview

Serpent is a snake title where relive retro excitement in Serpent, a modern twist on Snake. Maneuver your growing snake to eat and avoid collisions while collecting game plan pines for thrilling speed boosts. Strategize your moves in this visually nostalgic journey, balancing growth and agility to keep the game endlessly entertaining.
